t: The Twilight Zone: Gramma/Personal Demons/Cold Reading
d: A young boy cares for his grandmother, confronting fears to step up/A screenwriter with writer's block is haunted by unseen creatures/Actors in a radio play realize their words manifest reality.

t: The Twilight Zone: Wordplay/Dreams For Sale/Chameleon
d: A salesman stunned as others speak jumbled English/A woman's picnic fantasy shattered/A shuttle returns with an unusual find.

t: The Twilight Zone: Walking Distance
d: Martin Sloan, driving through the country, leaves his car and starts to walk toward his hometown, Homewood. He finds things exactly as they were when he was a child. He soon realizes he's gone back in time.

t: The Twilight Zone: Escape Clause
d: A hypochondriac exchanges his soul for immortality and indestructibility.

t: The Twilight Zone: The Lonely
d: Corry is stranded on an asteroid after being convicted of a crime. He receives as a present a robot who looks, sounds, and acts like a real woman.

t: The Twilight Zone: Time Enough at Last
d: A bank teller, Henry Bemis, longs for time alone to read books. He gets his wish...

t: The Twilight Zone: Healer/Children's Zoo/Kentucky Rye
d: Jackie steals a healing stone but loses his way/A girl's zoo visit transforms her parents' relationship/Bob enters a strange bar post-accident.

t: The Twilight Zone: Little Boy Lost/Wish Bank/Nightcrawlers
d: Photographer faces dilemma & encounters familiar boy/Janice gets lamp with wish restrictions/Trooper's diner stop unveils vet's nightmares.

t: The Twilight Zone: Perchance to Dream
d: A man is terrified of falling asleep for fear he might die.

t: The Twilight Zone: Judgment Night
d: In 1942, a German wonders why he's on the deck of a British steamship, with no memory of how he got there, and an overwhelming sense of impending doom.

t: The Twilight Zone: And When the Sky Was Opened
st: And When the Sky Was Opened
d: Three astronauts have returned from this first space flight. Major Gart is hospitalized with a broken leg. The other two, Colonels Harrington and Forbes head for a bar. Harrington gets a strange feeling…

t: The Twilight Zone: What You Need
d: A two-bit thug thinks he's found the key to a better life in an old sidewalk salesman who has the uncanny ability to tell people what they need the most.

t: The Twilight Zone: Ye Gods
d: Cupid arrives in the modern world. A love spell for his target does not work as well as he hopes.

t: The Twilight Zone: If She Dies
d: A year after his wife died a man is involved in a car accident that leaves his young daughter in a coma. On his way home the man has a vision.

t: The Twilight Zone: Examination Day/A Message From Charity
d: In the far future, twelve-year-old Dickie must take the government intelligence test/A 16-year old in 1985 finds himself in telepathic contact with a girl in 1700. Her knowledge of the future gets her accused of being a witch.

t: The Twilight Zone: The Four of Us are Dying
st: The Four of Us are Dying
d: A man who can change his face to resemble others gets into hot water with gangsters.

t: The Twilight Zone: Third From the Sun
d: With all-out nuclear war about to ignite, a scientist and his pilot friend plot to escape on an experimental spaceship.

t: The Twilight Zone: I Shot an Arrow into the Air
st: I Shot an Arrow into the Air
d: Three astronauts crash on what they believe to be an asteroid. Unfortunately, they have only limited water supplies to sustain them.

t: The Twilight Zone: The Hitch-Hiker
d: Alone on a cross-country trip, a woman continually sees the same hitch-hiker everywhere she looks.

t: The Twilight Zone: Teacher's Aide/Paladin of the Lost Hour
st: Teacher's Aide/Paladin of the Lost Hour
d: A teacher on a violent and gang-infested high school has trouble controlling her students/A Vietnam vet named Billy saves an old man named Gaspar from a mugging at a cemetery.

t: The Twilight Zone: Act Break/The Burning Man/Dealer's Choice
d: Landlord pesters Maury, whose partner dies. Maury wishes for Shakespeare as partner, travels back in time/Woman encounters odd hitchhiker/Poker game newcomer raises suspicion with repeated card draws.

t: The Twilight Zone: The Fever
d: Tight-fisted Franklin Gibbs is not pleased when his wife wins a trip for two to Las Vegas. But things change when he falls under the spell of a slot machine that calls his name.

t: The Twilight Zone: The Last Flight
d: A World War I flying ace flies through a mysterious cloud - and lands at a modern U.S. airbase in the year 1959!

t: The Twilight Zone: The Purple Testament
d: Lt. Fitzgerald has found his own special wartime hell. Looking into the faces of his men prior to battle, he has the disquieting ability to see who is about to die.

t: The Twilight Zone: Elegy
d: Three astronauts land on what looks like Earth 200 years before they left--only all of the people seem frozen in time.

t: The Twilight Zone: Wong's Lost and Found Emporium
d: David Wong searches for something he lost. He seeks the Lost and Found Emporium where he finds others looking for their lost items.

t: The Twilight Zone: Dead Woman's Shoes
d: Shy Maddie finds a pair of shoes and after trying them on is possessed by the vengeful spirit of a rich murdered woman.
